name: Jellycap
description: Plays a short recap before an episode (Android TV friendly).
overview: Builds a recap video from previous episodes (and from the already-watched part of a resumed episode) with ffmpeg, then tells the Android TV client to play it before the episode.
changelog: 1.1.1.0: Fix recaps failing on Jellyfin 10.11 and newer (TypeLoadException for Jellyfin.Data.Enums.SortOrder). Episodes are now ordered by the plugin instead of the library query.
